gates.name: BASELINE_AND_AUTHORITY
tests: G0-01 source hashes match
G0-02 C state schema readable
G0-03 repeat state schema readable
G0-04 work-control log path preserved

gates.name: IDLE_TRUTH
tests: G1-01 C disabled plus no repeat commands equals working zero
G1-02 stale A/E status is excluded
G1-03 open browser alone does not equal working
G1-04 error count is current C/command error only

gates.name: C_BATCH_AND_REPORTS
tests: G2-01 START dispatches commander and all workers once
G2-02 WAVE dispatches all targets without completion gating
G2-03 wrong WAVE report is ignored
G2-04 duplicate result does not increment task count
G2-05 END stops current assignment but new task reactivates role

gates.name: TIME_AND_MISSING_REPORT
tests: G3-01 one or two missing after 20 minutes becomes carryover
G3-02 three or more missing after 20 minutes waits
G3-03 two rescue workers after 90 minutes
G3-04 exactly four explicit missing-report failures before replacement
G3-05 expected-minutes value never becomes automatic success

gates.name: REPEAT_COMMAND
tests: G4-01 user text is byte-preserved
G4-02 time trigger does not queue duplicates
G4-03 completion trigger requires ROLE plus COMMAND_ID
G4-04 unrelated result is ignored
G4-05 END auto-stops the target
G4-06 restart restores enabled commands

gates.name: TARGET_PC_UI_AND_INSTALL
tests: G5-01 exact-base install and temporary-profile smoke
G5-02 group C button visible and scoped
G5-03 top command popup visible
G5-04 runtime and browser profile preserved
G5-05 rollback restores prior launcher

gates.name: LIVE_3_WORKER_3_ROUND
tests: G6-01 three workers receive one batch per round
G6-02 three completed rounds
G6-03 duplicate dispatch zero
G6-04 previous command cancellation zero
G6-05 counter final three

gates.name: RECOVERY_AND_LTS
tests: G7-01 restart mid-wave resumes
G7-02 GitHub temporary failure retries without duplicate
G7-03 browser navigation failure is logged and recoverable
G7-04 work-control log has no lost terminal transition
G7-05 independent acceptance passes
